quote: You will need to produce proof of address and identification, complete some forms and attend for a New Patient Check appointment which the Receptionist will book for you.

quote: If you don’t have proof of ID or address, you can still register.

name: F84014
quote: Prospective patients should provide photo identification and proof of address (i.e. passport, full UK driver’s licence, bank statement, utility bill).

name: F84050
quote: It is free to register with us, you do not have to provide photo ID or proof of address, and you do not need to prove your immigration status.

name: F84093
quote: It is not a requirement for adults to provide documentation but it is helpful for the registration process and beyond, so if you have it please do send it via email.

name: F84124
quote: You do not need any documents to register with us.

quote: When you register with our GP Practice, we might ask for ID or proof of address.

name: F84660
quote: Please note we may request that your share with us your proof of address (such as a recent utility bill or bank statement) and proof of ID and also your medical card if you have one.

name: F84717
quote: Please ensure you complete all sections of the PRF1 form, as well as providing proof of address and photo ID by presenting in person at the surgery reception desk.

quote: If you can provide photo ID and proof of address to speed up the process and correctly match your details please email these with any account details crossed out.
